candidate.answerReason: Pairwise coprimality forces the three prime powers in 27000=2^3·3^3·5^3 into separate integers, giving 8+27+125=160.

methods.label: Keep each prime power together
methods.explanation:
Pairwise relatively prime means that no two of the integers share a prime factor. Factor the given product:
\[
27000=27\cdot1000=2^3\cdot3^3\cdot5^3.
\]
All three copies of a particular prime must belong to the same integer; splitting them between two integers would give those integers a common factor.

Each integer is greater than \(1\), so each needs at least one prime factor. There are exactly three available primes and three integers. Thus each integer must contain exactly one of the complete prime powers. The integers are therefore \(8\), \(27\), and \(125\), in some order. They do satisfy the product and pairwise-coprimality conditions, and their sum is
\[
8+27+125=160.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{160}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
